verdict.rationale: Asana ships AI features (AI Teammates, AI Studio, an MCP server), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about excluding customer data from AI model training. The agent governance controls (scoped permissions, data access, audit trail) are a related but different control and earn no credit for a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
